subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Bangladesh has witnessed a surge in social movements in recent years, driven by a growing sense of civic consciousness and a desire for change. One notable movement is the "Clean Bangladesh" campaign, which has gained significant momentum, aiming to address the country's environmental challenges. (a)⎯⎯ facing various obstacles, the campaign has succeeded in raising awareness about pollution and inspiring individuals to take action. (b) ⎯⎯, the student-led "Road Safety Movement" has been instrumental in demanding safer roads and better transportation infrastructure. (c) ⎯⎯ progress has been made, challenges remain in implementing necessary reforms. (d) ⎯⎯, the "Digital Bangladesh" initiative has fostered technological advancements and improved access to information. (e) ⎯⎯, concerns persist regarding digital inequality and the potential for misuse of technology. Overall, these movements reflect a growing spirit of activism and a commitment to building a better Bangladesh.
guide_solution: (a) due to/because of (b) but (c) So (d) when (e) Consequently
